facts.text: Plymouth State University has organized its academic structure around seven Integrated Clusters that work across traditional, disciplinary boundaries.

sources.title: Integrated Clusters and Applied Schools < Plymouth State University
sources.quote: To best prepare our students to succeed and thrive in our region and within a 21st century global economy, Plymouth State University has organized around seven Integrated Clusters that work across traditional, disciplinary boundaries.

facts.text: Current Granite Guarantee students retain their eligibility for the duration of their undergraduate careers, while the New Hampshire Promise is open to eligible first-year and transfer students enrolling in fall 2027.
